## **Gene-level analysis: GSE130967**

#### loading and inspecting data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
gene_counts_vivo <- readRDS("Data/raw/data_in_vivo_gene.rds")
metadata_vivo <- readRDS("Data/raw/metadata_in_vivo.rds")
```

```{r}
#check columns / rows names
dim(gene_counts_vivo)
metadata_vivo <- metadata_vivo[colnames(gene_counts_vivo), ]
all(colnames(gene_counts_vivo) == rownames(metadata_vivo))
```

#### data quality control

```{r}
#only keeping genes that have at least one value that's not zero
gene_counts_vivo_filt <- gene_counts_vivo[rowSums(gene_counts_vivo) > 0, ]
#round decimal numbers to do DESeq2
gene_counts_vivo_filt <- round(gene_counts_vivo_filt)
```

#### standard differential gene expression

```{r}
all(rownames(metadata_vivo) == colnames(gene_counts_vivo_filt))
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_counts_vivo_filt, colData = metadata_vivo, design = ~ smoking)

#normalize data
vsd <-  vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "smoking") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("nonsmoker" = "maroon", "smoker" = "blue4")) +
  labs(title = "PCA: Smokers vs Non-smokers") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

#### PCA with confounders -\> sex and age

```{r}
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("smoking", "sex")) +
  labs(title = "PCA by Smoking and Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon", "navy", "pink", "#007fff")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
vsd$age_group <- cut(
  vsd$age,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 45, 60, Inf),
  labels = c("<45", "45-60", ">60")
)
age_smoke_colors <- c(
  "nonsmoker:<45"   = "#007fff", 
  "nonsmoker:45-60" = "blue",
  "nonsmoker:>60"   = "navy",
  "smoker:<45"      = "#ff99ff", 
  "smoker:45-60"    = "#CC33FF",
  "smoker:>60"      = "#cc0066"  
)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("smoking", "age_group")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = age_smoke_colors) +
  labs(title = "PCA by Smoking and Age", color = "Group : Age") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

#### DESeq2 -\> before and after correcting for confounders

```{r}
#base model
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res_before <- results(dds, contrast = c("smoking", "smoker", "nonsmoker"))
```

```{r}
#removing NA values
to_keep <- complete.cases(metadata_vivo[, c("smoking", "sex", "age")])
metadata_vivo_adjusted <- metadata_vivo[to_keep, ]
counts_vivo_adjusted <- gene_counts_vivo_filt[, to_keep]
```

```{r}
#adjust variables
metadata_vivo_adjusted$smoking <- relevel(metadata_vivo_adjusted$smoking, ref = "nonsmoker")
metadata_vivo_adjusted$age_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(metadata_vivo_adjusted$age))
```

```{r}
#correct model
dds_adjusted <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_vivo_adjusted, colData = metadata_vivo_adjusted, design = ~ sex + age_scaled + smoking)
dds_adjusted <- DESeq(dds_adjusted)
res_adjusted <- results(dds_adjusted, contrast = c("smoking", "smoker", "nonsmoker"))
```

```{r}
#confronting DESeq befor and after correcting for confounders
signif_before <- rownames(res_before)[!is.na(res_before$padj) & res_before$padj < 0.05]
signif_adjusted <- rownames(res_adjusted)[!is.na(res_adjusted$padj) & res_adjusted$padj < 0.05]
length(intersect(signif_before, signif_adjusted))
```

#### significantly differentially expressed genes

```{r}
gene_map <- isoInfo %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name) %>% distinct()
res_dataframe <- as.data.frame(res_adjusted) %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% left_join(gene_map, by = "gene_id") %>% arrange(padj)
degs <- res_dataframe %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
```

```{r}
nrow(degs) #total number of significant genes
sum(degs$log2FoldChange > 0) #number of significant genes with a positive log2FoldChange
sum(degs$log2FoldChange < 0) #number of significant genes with a negative log2FoldChange
```

#### volcano plots and heatmaps

```{r}
volcano_dataframe <- res_dataframe %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% mutate(status = case_when(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >  1 ~ "Up in Smokers", padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down in Smokers", TRUE ~ "Non Smokers"), mlog10padj = -log10(padj))
to_label <- volcano_dataframe %>% filter(status != "Non Smokers", !is.na(gene_name)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
ggplot(volcano_dataframe, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = mlog10padj, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = to_label, aes(label = gene_name), color = "black", size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down in Smokers" = "blue", "n.s." = "grey", "Up in Smokers" = "pink")) +
  labs(x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10(padj)", color = "Status", title = "Volcano Plot: Smokers vs Non-smokers") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
rld_adjusted <- vst(dds_adjusted, blind = TRUE)
top_ids <- head(degs$gene_id, 30)
mat_top <- assay(rld_adjusted)[top_ids, ]
rownames(mat_top) <- degs$gene_name[match(top_ids, degs$gene_id)]
```

```{r}
pheatmap(mat_top, scale = "row", annotation_col = metadata_vivo_adjusted[, c("smoking", "sex", "age")], show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize_row = 9, main = "Top 30 DEGs"
)
```

#### saving results

```{r}
saveRDS(res_dataframe, file = "Data/raw/results_in_vivo_df.rds")
saveRDS(degs, file = "Data/raw/significant_genes_vivo.rds")
```
